pinterest.title: 65W or 100W USB-C charger? Check this before you buy
pinterest.description: A 65W charger splits power when your phone is plugged in too. Here's when 100W actually makes sense for your laptop. AI voice & visuals. #CommissionsEarned

instagram.caption:
your 65W charger isn't always giving your laptop 65W 👀

plug your phone into the same brick and it splits. laptop drops to 45, phone gets 20. on a 100W one, the laptop keeps its 65.

quick rule:
→ just the laptop? 65W is plenty
→ laptop + phone every day? go 100W
